notes: v1.1.89: small update (only changed files). 2FA codes are now built against true internet time (NTP), not the host's clock - so on an RDP/VPS whose Windows clock has drifted (even 'Time synchronization failed') the tool still makes the correct code and Facebook stops rejecting a valid 2FA key. No admin and no system-clock change needed; falls back to the local clock if the internet is unreachable. Applies to every login path (browser, mobile, emulator, account-create, 2FA-change).
